list.title: Chats
list.searchPlaceholder: Search title, first prompt, project, id…
list.stateAllHint: Every chat, whatever it is doing
list.stateWorkingHint: A process is generating or running tools
list.stateWaitingHint: Stopped for a permission, a question or a plan
list.workersHint: The chats that carry out the tasks of an orchestration: their home is the orchestration board
list.internalHint: Housekeeping chats of Agentry itself (the planner, the auth check)
list.emptyBody: Chats you start here, and the ones Claude Code has run in an imported project, appear in this list.

new.title: New chat
new.subtitle: Starts a Claude Code conversation that Agentry keeps
new.promptHint: Drop or paste files onto the prompt to attach them.
new.modelHint: Alias or full model id. Empty = CLI default
new.permissionModeHint: Can be changed while the chat works
new.accountHint: Pins the chat to one claude-swap account instead of the active one
new.askHere: Answer permission prompts, questions and plans from the panel (off: whatever would ask is denied)

runWorkflow.argsHint: Optional: handed to the script as `args` (text or JSON)
runWorkflow.modelHint: For the chat that launches it; the script can pick its own per agent
runWorkflow.intro: Scripts in the project's .claude/workflows/ and in your own. Running one starts a chat that launches it, so its prompts come to this panel.
runWorkflow.emptyBody: Save one from a chat with the Workflow tool, or write a script in .claude/workflows/.
